# ALIGNMENT -- boss sprite art.  "@boss NAME" = a 64x32 canvas: two 32x32
# frames side by side (frame 0 left, frame 1 right).  Each frame is split into
# 16 tiles, 4x4 row-major; the game copies one boss (32 tiles) into sprite tiles
# BOSS_TILE_BASE..127 and draws it with SPAL_BOT (DMG: OBP1):
#   . transparent   1 #1a1028 dark   2 #6c6488 gunmetal   3 #ff2ca8 hot magenta

# Sentinel: armoured crab walker, faces LEFT (X flip = right).  Big slit core
# eye at the front, dorsal twin cannon (muzzle at x=5, y=4..5), 4 legs.
# Frame 1 = the other step (front leg lifted).
@boss BOSS_SENTINEL
